messages:
maya: Heads-up: strange routing pattern started ~10m ago. A bunch of tiered customers in EU getting routed to aux-us variants, causing unexpected egress and token-cost spike. Notable: traffic keeps flip-flopping between variant-v1-eu and variant-v2-us.
jordan: seeing it too. looks like fallback from v1->v2 then v2 rejects and falls back to v1 again -> loop. metrics: 5xxs + double egress counts. Dashboard: /routes/tiers shows repeated circuit toggles.
maya: attaching quick snippet from router logs:
maya: ```\n2024-06-21T08:12:07Z ROUTER route_id=rt-203 tier=premium tenant=acme source=eu region_assigned=eu-primary fallback=variant-v2-us
2024-06-21T08:12:07Z SERVE reject backend=variant-v2-us reason=compat-mismatch
2024-06-21T08:12:07Z ROUTER fallback to=variant-v1-eu
2024-06-21T08:12:07Z ROUTER route_id=rt-203 tier=premium tenant=acme assigned=variant-v2-us
``` 
maya: you can see the immediate reassign -> loop
rahul: probable cause: our compatibility predicate for v2-us doesn't block if region!=us, so router retries cross-region variant instead of picking local degraded path. also no circuit-breaker on repeated variant swaps.
sara: this is hitting dedicated customers — we need both quick mitigation (stop cross-region fallbacks) and follow-up (circuit + telemetry). priority: high.
leo: temp mitigation suggestion: add routing policy gate that prevents cross-region variant selection for EU tenants when eu capacity > 0. quick patch in router config: ```\nroute_policy {
  allow_cross_region_fallback: false if region==eu and local_capacity>0
}
``` 
devex: UX note — the rollout UI surfaced a 'fallback enabled' flag but it wasn't clear it allows cross-region. We should add an explicit checkbox and tooltip.
jordan: I'll push a hotfix to routing rules and enable a cooldown so the same route can't flip more than once per 30s (circuit window). patch: set variant_swap_cooldown=30s for tiered routes.
maya: @jordan do it. also throttle fallback attempts per-tenant to 3/minute.
jordan: starting hotfix now. tagging @ops oncall
deploy-bot: Deployment started: router-hotfix-1719001 by jordan
devex: can we add a short-lived dashboard breakpoint showing 'fallback swaps per-route' + per-tenant egress to track cost? I can whip one up on Console
rahul: adding a telemetry probe: emit metric route.variant_swap{route_id,tenant,from_variant,to_variant} with labels. that'll let us count loops quickly.
leo: put a short-term alert if swap_rate > 5/min for a single tenant.
sara: customer success — I'll message the impacted customers (ACME + two others) with a short note + workaround (pin variant to eu in tenant settings) while we stabilize.
jordan: hotfix deployed to canary
deploy-bot: Canary success: router-hotfix-1719001 @ canary cluster
ops-bot: Alert suppressed: routing-loop-eu count down to baseline
maya: observed immediate drop in cross-region egress and swap rate after cooldown in canary. rolling to prod in 5m
rahul: follow-up items (postmortem): 1) make cross-region fallback explicit per-tenant 2) implement variant-swap circuit-breaker with backoff 3) add unit tests for compatibility predicate 4) surface per-route swap telemetry in Console 5) update rollout UX to show cross-region implications
devex: I'll own the UX bit. suggestion: when enabling fallback, show a tooltip: "Fallback may select variants in other regions if local variants are incompatible; toggle to restrict to same-region" with a one-click pin.
sara: I'll coordinate comms and update customers. we should offer credits for unexpected egress.
maya: thanks everyone. I'll open the incident thread in incidents/ and start the timeline. closing here once prod rollout completes.
jordan: prod rollout complete, swap-rate back to normal range. closing thread :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Incident closed: routing-loop-eu -> resolved by router-hotfix-1719001
